case_name: In Re: Dolgonti Raghava Reddy And Anr. vs Unknown

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dolgonti Raghava Reddy and another (husband, wife)

facts_of_case: A-1 married A-2 in a temple, despite his existing marriage. Prosecution claimed they committed the offence under Section 494 I.P.C. Trial Court found them guilty and awarded sentence.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnised in contravention of Section 5(i) is void.
legal_principles.held: Section 11 declares a marriage which has been solemnised in contravention of section 6(1) shall be void.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnised after the commencement of this Act is void if on the date of such marriage, either party had a spouse living.
legal_principles.held: Any marriage between two Hindus after the commencement of this Act is void if on the date of such marriage, either party had a husband or wife living and provisions of sections 494 and 495 I. P. C. shall apply accordingly.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage must be celebrated with proper ceremonies and in due form according to the customs in the community to which the parties belong.
legal_principles.held: Unless therefore the marriage is celebrated or performed with proper, ceremonies in due form, it cannot be said to be a marriage solemnised for the purpose of Section 17.

outcome.final_order: Sentence confirmed, direction to execute bond for good behaviour also confirmed
